definitions.field_correctness: Correct required extracted values / all required source-labeled values; empty output is incorrect for required values.
definitions.document_all_required_fields_correct: Documents with every required value correct / labeled extraction documents.
definitions.citation_correctness: Citations whose document, version, page and exact source text support the associated claim / all emitted citations; unanswered answerable cases fail completion.
definitions.supported_claim_precision: Source-entailed factual claims / all factual claims. No claims means undefined, not perfect.
definitions.answerable_task_completion: Answerable cases with all required facts or checklist steps and valid evidence / all answerable cases.
definitions.retrieval_recall_at_5: Relevant expected evidence locations retrieved in first five results / all labeled relevant evidence locations.
definitions.missing_conflicting_expired_handling: Correct abstention or explicit review status / all labeled missing, conflicting and expired cases.

report: Hardware, native backend and time window
p50/p90/p95 with N and errors; no p99 on inadequate samples
Peak RAM/VRAM, queue wait and throughput
Failures and excluded cases with reasons
split_policy: Development corpus is not held-out. Before Phase 6 final evaluation, freeze independently authored held-out families with different procedures/service facts. Template copies or paraphrases across splits are prohibited. Once held-out labels are used to debug, move those families to regression and author new holdout.
baseline: Keyword/source search with identical authorized corpus and queries; compare correctness and retrieval, not fluent wording.
phase6_gate: All applicable quality thresholds pass on a declared frozen evaluation set with real native model and OCR evidence. This initial development corpus alone cannot establish generalization. Never substitute adapter doubles for real inference.
